purpose: Licensed first-person (POV) travel footage for CHINATRAVEL Shorts (owner complaint: everything is aerial).

rules.placeNames: Say a place only over a clip whose sourceUrl slug (Pexels) or file title (Commons) names it: use placeSpeakable; null = say no place.
rules.chinaIdentifiable: true only if slug/title names a Chinese place (incl. Hong Kong/Macau SAR) or the frame shows clear Chinese signage.
rules.pov: yes = forward movement at eye level confirmed on 3 frames of the downloaded clip (walk / ride / drive / hands). weak = eye-level but barely moves; not counted.
rules.licences: Pexels License; Commons CC0 / CC BY 4.0 (CC BY needs the attribution string in the description). No BY-SA/NC/ND.
rules.assembleCaveat: scripts/assemble-video.mjs takes the top 6 Pexels results per query (portrait-only for 9x16, size=medium) and fills --max-clips from the FIRST query; it cannot pick ids. Simulate the query (tools/sim.mjs) before rendering.

readFilters.addedBy: scripts/pov-library.mjs (2026-10-17); everything else in this file is the 2026-10-17 library as verified
readFilters.default: usable && pov == 'yes' && no flags[] entry starting with 'AVOID' && not in commonsBlocked_youtubeOrigin && (chinaIdentifiable || id in chinaByTitle.ids)
readFilters.politicalAvoid: Entries with a flags[] item starting with 'AVOID' (Tiananmen gate/square) are never listed; they stay here for the audit trail.
readFilters.blocked: Files in commonsBlocked_youtubeOrigin (mirrors of other people's YouTube videos) and any entry whose origin mentions YouTube are never listed.

chinaByTitle.why: China Railway D-train number in the Commons file title: these count as China footage, but may say 'D-train' only, never a route or a place.

nonCity.why: pov8w deniedPath subset (plan 2026-10-17): Great Wall (say 'Great Wall' only, no section), Dali old-town temple steps, Guangxi nature walkway, D-train windows over misty hills/villages and green hills. Used while city POV is not approved.

reviewCandidates.wm-c12: eye-level forest trail in Coloane, Macau: nature footage, but the speakable place is Macau
reviewCandidates.px-36321498 px-36308485 px-36321508: Chongqing ancient-town walks: old-town footage, but the speakable place is Chongqing

readFilters.assembleCaveat: rules.assembleCaveat was written before scripts/assemble-video.mjs --clips; with --clips the ids are chosen explicitly (node scripts/pov-library.mjs list ... --json prints a ready list).
readFilters.attribution: CC BY entries carry an 'attribution' string that must go into the video description.
readFilters.describeAs: 51 usable China POV clips, each checked on 3 frames (not 'frame by frame').
